invariants.name: assert_no_memory_write_for_case
invariants.sql:
SELECT count(*)::int AS c FROM memory_items
          WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND source_thread_id = $2 AND created_at >= $3

invariants.name: assert_one_outbound_for_case

SELECT count(*)::int AS c FROM outbound_delivery_ledger_claude_mcp
          WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND idempotency_key = $2
